about: Checks as data (plan item 1; design note claude/checks-design.md, agreed by Rob 23 Nov 2026). A check is one line on the report: a neutral topic, the layers that answer it in each region, the kind of answer, and how far it looks at each scale. The run carries out every check that applies, in code, before the analyst starts, and each comes back as found, none found, or not checked with the reason. Replaces 'baseline' in trusted.json. Edit by hand; js/checks.js reads it and test/checks.test.mjs and the invariants test check it.

fields.answer: count_by_band (features per distance band, plus the nearest), value_at_site (a reading over the site: elevation, depth, traffic) or inside (whether the site is inside or touching one)
fields.reach_km: how far the check looks at each scale, from the footprint edge. null means the check doesn't apply at that scale. Value checks have no reach (they read the site). Reach values are a first cut from research-reach-evidence.md, defaults to tune on the example sites.
fields.applies: setting: any, land (onshore), offshore, or sea (offshore or the coast within reach). where: a [west, south, east, north] box the site must overlap for the check to apply at all (e.g. tropical coral reefs); without it, the check applies everywhere in that setting.
fields.must: a check whose topic can't be called clear without it; drives the decision rule (js/industry.js settleDecision)
fields.sources: per region, first match wins. countries (onshore: the site must be in one), not_countries, and where (a box the site must overlap; offshore sites match on the box). atlas_id: an AI Living World Atlas record; record holds its title, publisher and licence as the atlas gave them on as_of (the atlas contract has no record-by-id lookup, so the run doesn't fetch them). tool: a Tobler tool instead of an atlas layer (boundaries, elevation, depth, traffic). pending: a layer we know exists but can't use yet (not checked, with this reason). If no source matches, the answer is not checked: no source for this region.

scales.about: Distance bands per scale (agreed 23 Nov; docs/conceptual-model.md). Until plan item 3 puts them in the profile, the run picks the scale from the screening distances already chosen (js/checks.js screenScale).
